summary: Andy Porter, 30, of Fairplay was seriously injured in a dirt bike crash on Forest Service Road 376 near Spanish Mill northeast of Buena Vista; Chaffee County SAR-North deployed 4x4s and ATVs to reach him over rugged muddy terrain, and a Flight for Life helicopter flew him to St. Anthony Hospital with broken ribs, collarbone and possibly sternum
location: Forest Service Road 376 near Spanish Mill, northeast of Buena Vista
responding_agency: Chaffee County SAR-North; Flight for Life
notes: Run 625 (Flume first chunk): 2015-03-14 weekday-verified Saturday; Flume article reprinted from the Chaffee County Times
